content:
🌎 BEYOND THE 956

A Miami jury convicted psychologist Maria Ximena Duarte, 48, on Tuesday, November 10, 2026, of lewd and lascivious exhibition and an unnatural and lascivious act in a case involving a 15-year-old girl, while acquitting her of the most serious charge she faced, human trafficking.

Prosecutors said Duarte approached the girl in August 2024 while she was walking her dog outside a Miami hotel. They said Duarte used her background in psychology to gain the teenager's trust, then allegedly engaged in sexual activity in front of her and encouraged her to have sex with adult men, including Duarte's boyfriend, Jason Mojica.

Two of the men, including Mojica, pleaded guilty to having sex with the minor and testified against Duarte during her trial. Mojica was sentenced to seven years in prison followed by probation. The other man, Hermes Mejia, also pleaded guilty and received probation, according to reports.

Miami-Dade Circuit Judge Ellen Sue Venzer ordered Duarte taken into custody after the verdict. She faces up to 15 years in prison, with sentencing scheduled for January 11, 2027. Duarte was arrested in August 2024.

Sources: WorldStar (@worldstar) on Instagram; People; The Sun; Miami Herald; The Daily Crime.
